sentences.1: A DPIA is required for a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling.
sentences.2: A DPIA is required at least in the following cases: a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling
sentences.3: You need to be confident that you can demonstrate that the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing are all similar when relying on a previously completed substantially similar DPIA.
sentences.4: You need to be confident that you can demonstrate that the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing are all similar.
sentences.5: Individuals can be vulnerable where circumstances may restrict their ability to freely consent or object to the processing of their personal data, or to understand its implications.
sentences.6: Individuals can be vulnerable where circumstances may restrict their ability to freely consent or object to the processing of their personal data, or to understand its implications.
sentences.7: Any processing of genetic data, other than that processed by an individual GP or health professional for the provision of health care direct to the data subject, requires a DPIA where this processing is combined with any of the criteria from the European guidelines.
sentences.8: Genetic data: any processing of genetic data, other than that processed by an individual GP or health professional for the provision of health care direct to the data subject.
